API ReferenceZIdentity APIUsersUsers Ops Mfa
Users Ops Mfa
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/users/:id:setskipmfa

Sets a flag to skip Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for a specified user ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

The user ID of the individual for whom the MFA needs to be skipped.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
timestamp
int32
REQUIRED

The timestamp indicating when the MFA skip action was set, usually represented in epoch time.

Responses
​
200
401

The request was successful, and MFA skip has been set.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
string
string
